raw:
The 2015 Spanish Grand Prix was held at the Circuit de Barcelona-Catalunya on 10 May 2015 (round 5 of the season). According to the race report, Nico Rosberg (Mercedes) won, started from pole position, ahead of his teammate Lewis Hamilton in second and Sebastian Vettel (Ferrari) in third.

ANSWER: Nico Rosberg
